description: Built 31-10-2026 from VATSIM Scandinavia's EFHK pilot briefing. Unlike LSZH/EGCC, the source gives two INDEPENDENT ranked fallback lists (arrivals: 15,22L,04L,04R,22R,33; departures: 22R,22L,04R,33,04L,15), walked down separately until wind permits, not fixed pairs. Modelled as the cross-product of arrival-rank x departure-rank (36 combos), minus 6 where arrival/departure are opposite ends of the same strip (04L/22R, 04R/22L, 15/33), leaving 30 modes, id '<arrRwy>A<depRwy>D'. Penalty=(arrRank-1)+(depRank-1); additively separable, so minimising it over wind-eligible modes reproduces independent per-role fallback EXACTLY, given how eligibility.ts checks each used runway -- see docs/EFHK_RUNWAY_RESEARCH.md section 0. No mode overrides maxCrosswindKt (defaultCrosswindKt=20 matches the briefing's dry figure). NOT modelled: the stricter 15kt CONTAMINATED crosswind limit -- no schema field, no snow/ice state in the DRY/WET/WET_POSSIBLE model. Full detail: docs/EFHK_RUNWAY_RESEARCH.md.

modes.description: Arrival rank 1 (15) + departure rank 1 (22R). Both roles at their most-preferred runway.
Arrival rank 1 (15) + departure rank 5 (04L). Departure rank 4 (33) is excluded: 33 is 15's own physical reciprocal and cannot be used as a departure runway while 15 is in use for arrivals.
Arrival rank 1 (15) + departure rank 6 (15). Single-runway mixed mode: 15 used for both arrivals and departures.
Arrival rank 2 (22L) + departure rank 2 (22L). Single-runway mixed mode.
Arrival rank 2 (22L) + departure rank 4 (33). Departure rank 3 (04R) is excluded: 04R is 22L's own physical reciprocal.
Arrival rank 3 (04L) + departure rank 2 (22L). Departure rank 1 (22R) is excluded: 22R is 04L's own physical reciprocal.
Arrival rank 3 (04L) + departure rank 5 (04L). Single-runway mixed mode.
Arrival rank 4 (04R) + departure rank 3 (04R). Single-runway mixed mode. Departure rank 2 (22L) is excluded: 22L is 04R's own physical reciprocal.
Arrival rank 5 (22R) + departure rank 1 (22R). Single-runway mixed mode.
Arrival rank 5 (22R) + departure rank 6 (15). Departure rank 5 (04L) is excluded: 04L is 22R's own physical reciprocal.
Arrival rank 6 (33) + departure rank 4 (33). Single-runway mixed mode.
Arrival rank 6 (33) + departure rank 5 (04L). Departure rank 6 (15) is excluded: 15 is 33's own physical reciprocal.
